description_en: This operation returns details about the runtime steps for a data migration or data synchronization task
description_zh: 本接口用于查询数据迁移或数据同步任务运行步骤的详情
name: DescribeProjectSteps

parameters.help_en: The data migration or data synchronization task ID

parameters.name: id

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is deprecated. We recommend that you use the `Code` parameter in `ErrorDetail` instead

items.description_en: The details of a task step

Description.description_en: The description of the step. Possible values include: pre-check, schema migration, schema synchronization, full migration, full synchronization, full verification, index migration, incremental log fetching, incremental synchronization, incremental verification, and forward switchover
